    'https://www.biblioteca.presidencia.gov.br/presidencia/ex-presidentes/jose-sarney/discursos/1989',
    'https://acervo.trf3.jus.br/uploads/r/tribunal-regional-federal-da-3-regiao-2/9/4/d/94d49e5a6ae1d3d25f4cc746cd591ab174986352bbccf0b90a67ce86f65477d5/JR0007.pdf',
    'https://acervo.trf3.jus.br/uploads/r/tribunal-regional-federal-da-3-regiao-2/9/4/d/94d49e5a6ae1d3d25f4cc746cd591ab174986352bbccf0b90a67ce86f65477d5/JR0007.pdf',
    'https://www.bcb.gov.br/controleinflacao/planoreal?modalAberto=30anosreal_noticia4',
]
RAW = [
    ('Cruzado', '1986-02-28', 242.23, 363.41),
    ('Bresser', '1987-06-12', 79.66, 980.21),
    ('Verao', '1989-01-15', 980.21, 1620.97),
    ('Collor I', '1990-03-16', 1972.91, 472.70),
    ('Collor II', '1991-01-31', 1620.97, 1119.10),
    ('Real', '1994-07-01', 2477.15, 22.41),
]
plans = []
for i, (name, launch, before, after) in enumerate(RAW):
    start = date.fromisoformat(launch)
    end = date.fromisoformat(RAW[i + 1][1]) if i < 5 else None
    months = ((end.year - start.year) * 12 + end.month - start.month - (end.day < start.day)) if end else 60
    drop = max(0, min(1, 1 - after / before))
    score = .7 * drop + .3 * min(months, 60) / 60
    sources = list(dict.fromkeys([IPCA, DATES[i]] + ([DATES[i + 1]] if end else [])))
    plans.append(dict(plan=name, launch_date=launch, ipca_before=before, ipca_after=after, months_lasted=months, score=score, sources=sources))
ranked = sorted(plans, key=lambda p: p['score'], reverse=True)

    'plans': plans,

        'months': 'Completed months between launch dates, subtracting one when the end day precedes the start day. Real receives 60 by RUBRIC.md.',
        'Real_launch': 'Currency introduction on 1994-07-01, rather than earlier preparation.',
        'provenance': 'URLs support inputs. Durations and scores are calculated under local RUBRIC.md, not reported by the linked sources.'
    }
}
Path('result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')

    '',

    '',
    '**Method and assumptions.** Annual IPCA comes from the [IBGE historical table](' + IPCA + '). Before and after are the calendar years immediately preceding and following launch. Durability counts completed months between the listed launches, subtracting a month if the ending day precedes the starting day. Use the [real currency introduction](' + DATES[5] + ') as Real\'s launch, rather than its preparatory stages. The local RUBRIC.md supplies the weights, clamping and fixed Real horizon. Those assumptions have no public-source URL. All table scores and durations are calculations from linked inputs.',
    '',
    '| Plan | Launch | Annual IPCA before → after (%) | Months* | Score* |',
    '|---|---|---|---:|---:|',
]
for i, p in enumerate(plans):

    month_links = '; '.join('[date](' + u + ')' for u in month_urls)
